nodes.description: The flight holds the camera controller's rest from takeoff until the opened board has taken over and fitted. Both pictures inherit the same near or far reading during the flight; releasing the hold applies the opened board's reading once. Reduced motion, missing prefetched pictures and interrupted flights use the plain opening path.

nodes.name: Work out the flight
nodes.responsibility: Where a board sits inside its card, and the cameras at the two ends of the flight, so the end stands where the opened board stands

nodes.name: Place a board in its card
nodes.responsibility: Puts the board's picture inside its card on the surface, fades the two pictures across the flight, and lets a press end it
nodes.description: A flight fades the shared chip along with both layers of words, and the child picture inherits the surface's held near or far reading.

nodes.name: Open or leave a board
nodes.responsibility: Follows a card's drill-down and goes back a level, handing each to the flight with the plain move to end it with

nodes.name: Light the whole route
nodes.responsibility: Gives a lit relationship its own ink on a stretch of a shared lane that the picture has another relationship draw, so the line is lit from its source to its target

nodes.name: Camera controller
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera controls, immediate pinches, eased wheel and key moves, and when the camera rests
nodes.description: useBoardCamera creates one external camera store, delegates arithmetic to camera.ts and easing to useCameraMotion, and exposes camera reads and subscriptions to the diagram and its surface. A hand's move rests after cameraRest and after its ease ends. A zoom drops its compositor layer first, then releases the far reading on the next frame; a pan rests immediately.

nodes.name: Camera store
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the live camera, its last resting camera, the moving flag and subscribers outside React
nodes.description: Only subscribed presentation readers redraw on a camera change. While a hand moves it or a flight holds it, the rest stays where it was. The surface reads moving to keep its transform layer; SemanticDiagram reads rest.scale for the near/far swap and traffic resumes from the same rest. This is presentation state, never a copy of board meaning.

nodes.name: Mark code warnings
nodes.responsibility: Draws the picture's warning triangle on each subject the last code pass warns about
nodes.description: Reads the findings of the board, variant and version on screen and puts the renderer's own warning mark in the subject's group, where the picture puts it on an undecided subject. The picture's markup stays the renderer's; information draws nothing.

nodes.name: Page start
nodes.responsibility: Starts this page's renderer and hands the viewer its picture source and cache once; learns the vault the server serves before the application renders, or replays a recorded talk

nodes.name: Catalogue queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the board listing for catalogue navigation

nodes.name: Vault diagnostic queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the vault check for its diagnostics panel

nodes.name: Pane vault
nodes.responsibility: Tells every reader in a pane which vault the pane is in
nodes.description: The pane provides its vault once, as a context, and each reader of the viewer takes it from here instead of through every component between them. The pane session is its one source: the value only passes down, and a reader drawn outside a pane is an error, because it could not say which vault it means.

nodes.name: Open a card's board
nodes.responsibility: Opens the board one level down from a card, in its own vault or in the vault of the repository the link names
nodes.description: Finds where the link lies, reads the target there, and opens the variant the link names. A link into a repository this machine cannot read opens nothing, and the inspector says why.

nodes.name: Keep the drill trail
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the boards a reader came through, also across the move of the pane into another repository's vault
nodes.description: The trail is a pure reducer (lib/drill-trail.ts). A board of another vault is a move that the browser client makes: the trail waits for that arrival and keeps the boards before it. Any other arrival is somebody else pointing the pane, and ends the trail.

nodes.name: Repository places
nodes.responsibility: The vault of each repository this machine lists, which the browser client provides to the viewer

beats.heading: Obtain authoritative meaning
beats.body: ApplicationPane mounts SemanticBoardStage. The entry point asks the query cache for the picture of its reading; the page draws it here from the board document and policy the server sent, keeps it stamped with that version, and only a page with no renderer asks the server's render route.

beats.heading: Own only the reading
beats.body: The stage presents explicit states. A new board, variant or view fits the whole reading until somebody pans or zooms, and picking a subject marks it through the atlas; none of it changes board content or geometry. The camera controller keeps live and resting camera state in an external presentation store; drags and pinches apply immediately, while wheel and key moves ease and far content changes after rest.

beats.heading: Explain across levels
beats.body: A walkthrough step is chosen by hand or driven by narration or a recording, and the camera fits its subjects. A drill-down opens exactly the variant it names, and a board's new version reads its picture and document again.

beats.heading: Say what is on screen
beats.body: The pane is told what is on screen whenever it changes: board, resolved variant, view, selection and walkthrough step. The pane session reports it to the server, where agents and voice read it, and a recording page paces itself by it.

beats.heading: A replay steps the viewer on its own clock
beats.body: The replay page mounts the same viewer on a recorded talk. Board reads answer the talk's snapshot instead of the server, so every refetch returns the same board. The camera glide and the picture transition read the frame clock, which the replay steps 1/30 s at a time, so every frame is drawn at its exact time.

variants.name: TASK-475
variants.summary: The viewer, camera presentation store, host entry points and warning navigation

nodes.name: Browser client
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer in each pane

nodes.name: Semantic viewer
nodes.responsibility: Explores one rendered architecture
nodes.description: The read-only semantic-board-canvas module. The board the server holds defines content; the picture is drawn in this page from it, or by the server's render route; local state defines only how a user reads it (ADR 0023). Its root exports the board-read and picture-source setup functions that the page start and replay call; those implementing children are public entry points.

nodes.name: Fetch semantic reads
nodes.responsibility: Decode the listing, a board, a render, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality
nodes.description: Plain fetch to the semantic read routes; refused, unreachable or invalid replies become explicit viewer failures carrying the server's code. There is no write call.

nodes.name: Resolve board meaning
nodes.responsibility: Inspect subjects and variants
nodes.description: Parses the board document, resolves the shown variant, describes nodes, edges, flows, steps, bindings, containment, and proposal standing.

nodes.name: Render stage states
nodes.responsibility: Present every reachable state
nodes.description: The pane's components. stageBody in SemanticStageView.tsx presents the waiting, problem, empty and drawn states, and says when the picture on screen is old, from the entry point's query and reading state. SemanticDiagram draws the picture and mounts its transition, gestures, lighting and marks. SemanticStageView lays the header with its way back and its two tabs, Diagram and About, the variant's standing, the About page over the picture while its tab is open, and the sidebar around them. The About page reads the board document the pane already holds: the variant's walkthroughs step by step, its parts in their containment, its relationships and the board's variants. A row picks its subject in the pane, a step presents its walkthrough from there, and a variant is read in the pane. The page writes nothing. SemanticBoardStage.tsx and Peek.tsx in the same directory are parts of their own. The header shows the board warning count and steps through each finding. A finding, like the control at the end of a row of the About page, asks the entry point to show its subject on the diagram.

nodes.name: Camera arithmetic
nodes.responsibility: Computes clamped camera transforms and fits without persisting board geometry
nodes.description: Pure camera.ts arithmetic supplies pan, pinch, zoom and fit transforms. The separate camera controller owns the live presentation store and when movement rests.

nodes.name: Select semantic subjects
nodes.responsibility: Map gestures through the atlas
nodes.description: Accepts only semantic IDs present in the server atlas and toggles the shared attention mark on rendered groups.

nodes.name: Follow drill-downs
nodes.responsibility: Navigate linked board levels, in this vault or another repository's
nodes.description: Decides where a link lies: the vault it is drawn in, the vault of the chosen checkout of the repository it names, or nowhere this machine can read (not listed, or a checkout that is gone or has no vault). Resolves the exact current or named target variant against the target board's document and says its lifecycle before it is opened; a named variant that is gone is reported, never swapped for the current one.

nodes.name: Drive walkthrough focus
nodes.responsibility: Focus each narrative beat
nodes.description: Maps beat subjects through the atlas to a focus rectangle and reports named subjects missing from the current view.

nodes.name: Refresh changed boards
nodes.responsibility: Invalidate live cached drawings
nodes.description: Hears a board's new version, with the vault it was written in, from the pane socket and, for the board on screen in that vault (or a name it had before a rename), cancels its reads in flight and invalidates its pictures and its document, keeping the last usable picture on screen.

nodes.name: Viewer entry point
nodes.responsibility: Mount queries and reading state
nodes.description: SemanticBoardStage, mounted by ApplicationPane. It asks the query cache for the picture of the reading on screen, owns the reading hooks (drill trail, level, variant, walkthrough, fit, report) and hands the answer to renderedView. It keeps the open tab, and how far down the About page was, with the board on screen. Its one show picks a subject, opens the diagram and fits the camera to the subject after the pick's own camera moves. A subject that the view on screen does not draw opens the whole board first.

nodes.name: Picture source
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's pictures come from: the renderer this page installed at start, or the server's render route

nodes.name: Picture cache
nodes.responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
nodes.description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown. A picture is of a board of one vault, so its key names the vault, and a listing forgets only the stale pictures of the vault it lists.

nodes.name: Draw here
nodes.responsibility: Draws the board in this tab, with the tab's own canvas and worker pool

nodes.name: Semantic queries
nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document, a picture and a board's locality
nodes.description: No timer: a picture and a document stay fresh until their board announces a new version, and are read again on a reconnect. The last picture of the same board stays as the placeholder while another reading of it is drawn. A board's locality is asked once for each pick of a part, and never on a timer, a return to the tab or a reconnect. Every key names a vault, because two repositories can each have a board of the same name: a board's news invalidates the keys of its own vault only.

nodes.name: Local pictures
nodes.responsibility: Draws a picture in this page from the board and policy the cache holds, and keeps it
nodes.description: Shows a kept picture only when its stamp matches the board's version, the policy and the renderer build; forgets pictures of boards that moved when the server lists them; draws a changed board's readings again ahead of time.

nodes.name: Keep fitted
nodes.responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms; lands at once on the board a flight arrived at
nodes.description: A new board, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back. The board a flight arrived at is fitted at once, because the flight has already put the camera there.

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading
nodes.responsibility: Tells the pane what is on screen, only when it changes
nodes.description: Board, resolved variant, view, selection, the drawn version and where a presented walkthrough has got to: what the pane session reports to the server, what an agent and voice read, and what a recording paces itself by.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers the semantic read routes

nodes.name: Camera glide
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
nodes.description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

nodes.name: Picture transition
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and the traffic's clock carries over; a picture a flight arrived at is put up as it is
nodes.description: It writes the picture into the surface itself, once per picture, and runs the traffic of each picture, ghost and borrowed group as it puts them up. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock, and the picture clock its traffic runs on is read and set through it, so a replay seeks every one of them to the frame's time. The picture of a board that a flight into a card arrived at is put up as it is, with no entrance. Continuing cards carry their one shared chip and moving words; content comparison ignores the per-picture placement properties, so a moved card keeps its shared content (picture-pairing.ts).

nodes.name: Board reads
nodes.responsibility: Where a board's document, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
nodes.description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation. A replay reads no findings and no locality.

nodes.name: Frame clock
nodes.responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
nodes.description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation at the frame's time: a picture's traffic, which carries the picture clock's id, at where that picture's clock stands, carried from the picture it replaced. An animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.

nodes.name: Walkthrough replay
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer on a recorded talk and steps it frame by frame
nodes.description: The page a recording's picture is rendered in (drawn on Browser application and Board rasterizer). Loading a talk points the board reads at it, installs the stepped clock and mounts the viewer on the talk's board, its step driven by the talk.

nodes.name: Picture traffic
nodes.responsibility: Runs a picture's traffic as Web Animations, so no SMIL runs in the page
nodes.description: The renderer draws traffic as SMIL so an exported file moves on its own. Before markup reaches the page, each SMIL element is taken out and kept as markup in an attribute of the element it animated, and its motion runs from there as a Web Animation that carries the picture clock's id. A copy of the picture keeps the attribute, so a ghost or a borrowed group runs its traffic again. A form it does not read stays SMIL.

nodes.name: Camera motion
nodes.responsibility: Eases the camera to where a wheel or a key sent it, a frame at a time
nodes.description: Each eased input changes where the camera is going. The loop keeps the zoom point under the pointer, ends when the camera is at rest and asks the frame clock for work only while moving. A pinch and a drag bypass this loop and apply at once; reduced motion also applies at once.

nodes.name: Diagram gestures
nodes.responsibility: Turns a press, a drag, a two-finger pinch and a click into a pan, a zoom, a pick or an open
nodes.description: A press within the pick tolerance selects what it landed on. A drag pans immediately and stops where released. A second touch pointer hands the gesture to useTouchPinch, which calls the camera controller with both fingers before and after each move. A press stops an eased move already under way.

nodes.name: Light connections
nodes.responsibility: Lights what a poked part is wired to and lets the rest of the picture recede
nodes.description: The part is the one the pointer has rested on for a moment, else the one picked out. The part, what it holds, every relationship with an end in any of it, the parts at their other ends and the containers that hold them stay as drawn; the surface says how strongly (pick or pointer). It stands down while a presented step or a group says what the picture is about, while the picture leaves, and for a part with nothing drawn to light.

nodes.name: Draw on lit relationships
nodes.responsibility: Draws each relationship that lights on from its source to its target, once
nodes.description: A sweep is a copy of the line laid over the picture for as long as it takes, animated on the document timeline, then settled into the line under it and taken away. The picture is not changed. A person who asked for reduced motion gets no sweep.

nodes.name: Ask the picture to show
nodes.responsibility: Carries what the sidebar asks of the picture: the relationship a row is pointed at, and a trace of what a part reaches
nodes.description: The stage provides it over the picture and the sidebar, which are siblings. Both asks belong to the part that is picked out and go when the pick does.

nodes.name: Trace what a part reaches
nodes.responsibility: Walks the relationships from a part, and what it holds, in one direction, and says how many hops away each subject is
nodes.description: Onward follows what the part sends to, back follows what sends to it. A subject reached by more than one route is as near as its nearest. The count of parts reached labels the control that asks for the trace.

nodes.name: Reveal a pick
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera, once, just far enough to bring a part picked from elsewhere than the picture into view
nodes.description: A row of the list, the part search or an agent can pick a part that is out of the pane. The part the reader was on comes along when the two are wired together and fit. A part already in view moves nothing, and a presented walkthrough or a panel over the picture keeps the camera.

beats.heading: Obtain authoritative meaning
beats.body: ApplicationPane mounts SemanticBoardStage. The entry point asks the query cache for the picture of its reading; the page draws it here from the board document and policy the server sent, keeps it stamped with that version, and only a page with no renderer asks the server's render route.

beats.heading: Own only the reading
beats.body: The stage presents explicit states. A new board, variant or view fits the whole reading until somebody pans or zooms, and picking a subject marks it through the atlas; none of it changes board content or geometry. The camera controller keeps live and resting camera state in an external presentation store; drags and pinches apply immediately, while wheel and key moves ease and far content changes after rest.

beats.heading: Explain across levels
beats.body: A walkthrough step is chosen by hand or driven by narration or a recording, and the camera fits its subjects. A drill-down opens exactly the variant it names, and a board's new version reads its picture and document again.

beats.heading: Say what is on screen
beats.body: The pane is told what is on screen whenever it changes: board, resolved variant, view, selection and walkthrough step. The pane session reports it to the server, where agents and voice read it, and a recording page paces itself by it.

beats.heading: A replay steps the viewer on its own clock
beats.body: The replay page mounts the same viewer on a recorded talk. Board reads answer the talk's snapshot instead of the server, so every refetch returns the same board. The camera glide and the picture transition read the frame clock, which the replay steps 1/30 s at a time, so every frame is drawn at its exact time.

variants.name: TASK-482.04
variants.summary: The viewer, camera presentation store, host entry points and warning navigation, gathered into four areas: the pictures' supply, the stage with its reads, the camera and the pointer, and the moves between pictures

nodes.name: Browser client
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer in each pane

nodes.name: Semantic viewer
nodes.responsibility: Explores one rendered architecture
nodes.description: The read-only semantic-board-canvas module. The board the server holds defines content; the picture is drawn in this page from it, or by the server's render route; local state defines only how a user reads it (ADR 0023). Its root exports the board-read and picture-source setup functions that the page start and replay call; those implementing children are public entry points.

nodes.name: Fetch semantic reads
nodes.responsibility: Decode the listing, a board, a render, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality
nodes.description: Plain fetch to the semantic read routes; refused, unreachable or invalid replies become explicit viewer failures carrying the server's code. There is no write call.

nodes.name: Resolve board meaning
nodes.responsibility: Inspect subjects and variants
nodes.description: Parses the board document, resolves the shown variant, describes nodes, edges, flows, steps, bindings, containment, and proposal standing.

nodes.name: Render stage states
nodes.responsibility: Present every reachable state
nodes.description: The pane's components. stageBody in SemanticStageView.tsx presents the waiting, problem, empty and drawn states, and says when the picture on screen is old, from the entry point's query and reading state. SemanticDiagram draws the picture and mounts its transition, gestures, lighting and marks. SemanticStageView lays the header with its way back and its two tabs, Diagram and About, the variant's standing, the About page over the picture while its tab is open, and the sidebar around them. The About page reads the board document the pane already holds: the variant's walkthroughs step by step, its parts in their containment, its relationships and the board's variants. A row picks its subject in the pane, a step presents its walkthrough from there, and a variant is read in the pane. The page writes nothing. SemanticBoardStage.tsx and Peek.tsx in the same directory are parts of their own. The header shows the board warning count and steps through each finding. A finding, like the control at the end of a row of the About page, asks the entry point to show its subject on the diagram.

nodes.name: Camera arithmetic
nodes.responsibility: Computes clamped camera transforms and fits without persisting board geometry
nodes.description: Pure camera.ts arithmetic supplies pan, pinch, zoom and fit transforms. The separate camera controller owns the live presentation store and when movement rests.

nodes.name: Select semantic subjects
nodes.responsibility: Map gestures through the atlas
nodes.description: Accepts only semantic IDs present in the server atlas and toggles the shared attention mark on rendered groups.

nodes.name: Follow drill-downs
nodes.responsibility: Navigate linked board levels, in this vault or another repository's
nodes.description: Decides where a link lies: the vault it is drawn in, the vault of the chosen checkout of the repository it names, or nowhere this machine can read (not listed, or a checkout that is gone or has no vault). Resolves the exact current or named target variant against the target board's document and says its lifecycle before it is opened; a named variant that is gone is reported, never swapped for the current one.

nodes.name: Drive walkthrough focus
nodes.responsibility: Focus each narrative beat
nodes.description: Maps beat subjects through the atlas to a focus rectangle and reports named subjects missing from the current view.

nodes.name: Refresh changed boards
nodes.responsibility: Invalidate live cached drawings
nodes.description: Hears a board's new version, with the vault it was written in, from the pane socket and, for the board on screen in that vault (or a name it had before a rename), cancels its reads in flight and invalidates its pictures and its document, keeping the last usable picture on screen.

nodes.name: Viewer entry point
nodes.responsibility: Mount queries and reading state
nodes.description: SemanticBoardStage, mounted by ApplicationPane. It asks the query cache for the picture of the reading on screen, owns the reading hooks (drill trail, level, variant, walkthrough, fit, report) and hands the answer to renderedView. It keeps the open tab, and how far down the About page was, with the board on screen. Its one show picks a subject, opens the diagram and fits the camera to the subject after the pick's own camera moves. A subject that the view on screen does not draw opens the whole board first.

nodes.name: Picture source
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's pictures come from: the renderer this page installed at start, or the server's render route

nodes.name: Picture cache
nodes.responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
nodes.description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown. A picture is of a board of one vault, so its key names the vault, and a listing forgets only the stale pictures of the vault it lists.

nodes.name: Draw here
nodes.responsibility: Draws the board in this tab, with the tab's own canvas and worker pool

nodes.name: Semantic queries
nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document, a picture and a board's locality
nodes.description: No timer: a picture and a document stay fresh until their board announces a new version, and are read again on a reconnect. The last picture of the same board stays as the placeholder while another reading of it is drawn. A board's locality is asked once for each pick of a part, and never on a timer, a return to the tab or a reconnect. Every key names a vault, because two repositories can each have a board of the same name: a board's news invalidates the keys of its own vault only.

nodes.name: Local pictures
nodes.responsibility: Draws a picture in this page from the board and policy the cache holds, and keeps it
nodes.description: Shows a kept picture only when its stamp matches the board's version, the policy and the renderer build; forgets pictures of boards that moved when the server lists them; draws a changed board's readings again ahead of time.

nodes.name: Keep fitted
nodes.responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms; lands at once on the board a flight arrived at
nodes.description: A new board, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back. The board a flight arrived at is fitted at once, because the flight has already put the camera there.

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading
nodes.responsibility: Tells the pane what is on screen, only when it changes
nodes.description: Board, resolved variant, view, selection, the drawn version and where a presented walkthrough has got to: what the pane session reports to the server, what an agent and voice read, and what a recording paces itself by.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers the semantic read routes

nodes.name: Camera glide
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
nodes.description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

nodes.name: Picture transition
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and the traffic's clock carries over; a picture a flight arrived at is put up as it is
nodes.description: It writes the picture into the surface itself, once per picture, and runs the traffic of each picture, ghost and borrowed group as it puts them up. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock, and the picture clock its traffic runs on is read and set through it, so a replay seeks every one of them to the frame's time. The picture of a board that a flight into a card arrived at is put up as it is, with no entrance. Continuing cards carry their one shared chip and moving words; content comparison ignores the per-picture placement properties, so a moved card keeps its shared content (picture-pairing.ts).

nodes.name: Board reads
nodes.responsibility: Where a board's document, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
nodes.description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation. A replay reads no findings and no locality.

nodes.name: Frame clock
nodes.responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
nodes.description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation at the frame's time: a picture's traffic, which carries the picture clock's id, at where that picture's clock stands, carried from the picture it replaced. An animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.

nodes.name: Walkthrough replay
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer on a recorded talk and steps it frame by frame
nodes.description: The page a recording's picture is rendered in (drawn on Browser application and Board rasterizer). Loading a talk points the board reads at it, installs the stepped clock and mounts the viewer on the talk's board, its step driven by the talk.

nodes.name: Picture traffic
nodes.responsibility: Runs a picture's traffic as Web Animations, so no SMIL runs in the page
nodes.description: The renderer draws traffic as SMIL so an exported file moves on its own. Before markup reaches the page, each SMIL element is taken out and kept as markup in an attribute of the element it animated, and its motion runs from there as a Web Animation that carries the picture clock's id. A copy of the picture keeps the attribute, so a ghost or a borrowed group runs its traffic again. A form it does not read stays SMIL.

nodes.name: Camera motion
nodes.responsibility: Eases the camera to where a wheel or a key sent it, a frame at a time
nodes.description: Each eased input changes where the camera is going. The loop keeps the zoom point under the pointer, ends when the camera is at rest and asks the frame clock for work only while moving. A pinch and a drag bypass this loop and apply at once; reduced motion also applies at once.

nodes.name: Diagram gestures
nodes.responsibility: Turns a press, a drag, a two-finger pinch and a click into a pan, a zoom, a pick or an open
nodes.description: A press within the pick tolerance selects what it landed on. A drag pans immediately and stops where released. A second touch pointer hands the gesture to useTouchPinch, which calls the camera controller with both fingers before and after each move. A press stops an eased move already under way.

nodes.name: Light connections
nodes.responsibility: Lights what a poked part is wired to and lets the rest of the picture recede
nodes.description: The part is the one the pointer has rested on for a moment, else the one picked out. The part, what it holds, every relationship with an end in any of it, the parts at their other ends and the containers that hold them stay as drawn; the surface says how strongly (pick or pointer). It stands down while a presented step or a group says what the picture is about, while the picture leaves, and for a part with nothing drawn to light.

nodes.name: Draw on lit relationships
nodes.responsibility: Draws each relationship that lights on from its source to its target, once
nodes.description: A sweep is a copy of the line laid over the picture for as long as it takes, animated on the document timeline, then settled into the line under it and taken away. The picture is not changed. A person who asked for reduced motion gets no sweep.

nodes.name: Ask the picture to show
nodes.responsibility: Carries what the sidebar asks of the picture: the relationship a row is pointed at, and a trace of what a part reaches
nodes.description: The stage provides it over the picture and the sidebar, which are siblings. Both asks belong to the part that is picked out and go when the pick does.

nodes.name: Trace what a part reaches
nodes.responsibility: Walks the relationships from a part, and what it holds, in one direction, and says how many hops away each subject is
nodes.description: Onward follows what the part sends to, back follows what sends to it. A subject reached by more than one route is as near as its nearest. The count of parts reached labels the control that asks for the trace.

nodes.name: Reveal a pick
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera, once, just far enough to bring a part picked from elsewhere than the picture into view
nodes.description: A row of the list, the part search or an agent can pick a part that is out of the pane. The part the reader was on comes along when the two are wired together and fit. A part already in view moves nothing, and a presented walkthrough or a panel over the picture keeps the camera.

nodes.name: Fly into a card
nodes.responsibility: Opens a card's board by flying the camera into the card, and goes back out the same way; a request it cannot fly opens the plain way
nodes.description: The flight holds the camera controller's rest from takeoff until the opened board has taken over and fitted. Both pictures inherit the same near or far reading during the flight; releasing the hold applies the opened board's reading once. Reduced motion, missing prefetched pictures and interrupted flights use the plain opening path.

nodes.name: Work out the flight
nodes.responsibility: Where a board sits inside its card, and the cameras at the two ends of the flight, so the end stands where the opened board stands

nodes.name: Place a board in its card
nodes.responsibility: Puts the board's picture inside its card on the surface, fades the two pictures across the flight, and lets a press end it
nodes.description: A flight fades the shared chip along with both layers of words, and the child picture inherits the surface's held near or far reading.

nodes.name: Open or leave a board
nodes.responsibility: Follows a card's drill-down and goes back a level, handing each to the flight with the plain move to end it with

nodes.name: Light the whole route
nodes.responsibility: Gives a lit relationship its own ink on a stretch of a shared lane that the picture has another relationship draw, so the line is lit from its source to its target

nodes.name: Camera controller
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera controls, immediate pinches, eased wheel and key moves, and when the camera rests
nodes.description: useBoardCamera creates one external camera store, delegates arithmetic to camera.ts and easing to useCameraMotion, and exposes camera reads and subscriptions to the diagram and its surface. A hand's move rests after cameraRest and after its ease ends. A zoom drops its compositor layer first, then releases the far reading on the next frame; a pan rests immediately.

nodes.name: Camera store
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the live camera, its last resting camera, the moving flag and subscribers outside React
nodes.description: Only subscribed presentation readers redraw on a camera change. While a hand moves it or a flight holds it, the rest stays where it was. The surface reads moving to keep its transform layer; SemanticDiagram reads rest.scale for the near/far swap and traffic resumes from the same rest. This is presentation state, never a copy of board meaning.

nodes.name: Mark code warnings
nodes.responsibility: Draws the picture's warning triangle on each subject the last code pass warns about
nodes.description: Reads the findings of the board, variant and version on screen and puts the renderer's own warning mark in the subject's group, where the picture puts it on an undecided subject. The picture's markup stays the renderer's; information draws nothing.

nodes.name: Page start
nodes.responsibility: Starts this page's renderer and hands the viewer its picture source and cache once; learns the vault the server serves before the application renders, or replays a recorded talk

nodes.name: Catalogue queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the board listing for catalogue navigation

nodes.name: Vault diagnostic queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the vault check for its diagnostics panel

nodes.name: Pane vault
nodes.responsibility: Tells every reader in a pane which vault the pane is in
nodes.description: The pane provides its vault once, as a context, and each reader of the viewer takes it from here instead of through every component between them. The pane session is its one source: the value only passes down, and a reader drawn outside a pane is an error, because it could not say which vault it means.

nodes.name: Open a card's board
nodes.responsibility: Opens the board one level down from a card, in its own vault or in the vault of the repository the link names
nodes.description: Finds where the link lies, reads the target there, and opens the variant the link names. A link into a repository this machine cannot read opens nothing, and the inspector says why.

nodes.name: Keep the drill trail
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the boards a reader came through, also across the move of the pane into another repository's vault
nodes.description: The trail is a pure reducer (lib/drill-trail.ts). A board of another vault is a move that the browser client makes: the trail waits for that arrival and keeps the boards before it. Any other arrival is somebody else pointing the pane, and ends the trail.

nodes.name: Repository places
nodes.responsibility: The vault of each repository this machine lists, which the browser client provides to the viewer

nodes.name: Picture supply
nodes.responsibility: Decides where a pane's picture is drawn, in this page or by the server's render route. Keeps each drawing only as a read-only cache stamped with the board version it came from.

nodes.name: Stage and reads
nodes.responsibility: Mounts the viewer in a pane and reads the board, its vault and the code findings from the server. Presents every reachable state of the answer and reports what is on screen.

nodes.name: Camera and pointer
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera, its fits, glides and eased moves. Turns presses, drags and hovers into picks and lit relationships.

nodes.name: Moves between pictures
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next, with the traffic each picture runs. Steps a walkthrough and follows a card's drill-down, in this vault or another repository's.

nodes.name: Variant timeline
nodes.responsibility: A board's variants as one timeline from its own record: the adopted line newest first, drafts branching off, a shelved variant ending its branch

nodes.name: Picture departure
nodes.responsibility: A picture leaving a pane for another board: it zooms into an opened card, draws away going back, else fades, and a late leaver finishes as a ghost

beats.body: ApplicationPane mounts SemanticBoardStage. The entry point asks the query cache for the picture of its reading; the page draws it here from the board document and policy the server sent, keeps it stamped with that version, and only a page with no renderer asks the server's render route.

beats.heading: Own only the reading
beats.body: The stage presents explicit states. A new board, variant or view fits the whole reading until somebody pans or zooms, and picking a subject marks it through the atlas; none of it changes board content or geometry. The camera controller keeps live and resting camera state in an external presentation store; drags and pinches apply immediately, while wheel and key moves ease and far content changes after rest.

beats.heading: Explain across levels
beats.body: A walkthrough step is chosen by hand or driven by narration or a recording, and the camera fits its subjects. A drill-down opens exactly the variant it names, and a board's new version reads its picture and document again.

beats.heading: Say what is on screen
beats.body: The pane is told what is on screen whenever it changes: board, resolved variant, view, selection and walkthrough step. The pane session reports it to the server, where agents and voice read it, and a recording page paces itself by it.

beats.heading: A replay steps the viewer on its own clock
beats.body: The replay page mounts the same viewer on a recorded talk. Board reads answer the talk's snapshot instead of the server, so every refetch returns the same board. The camera glide and the picture transition read the frame clock, which the replay steps 1/30 s at a time, so every frame is drawn at its exact time.

variants.name: TASK-482.06
variants.summary: The board is its own container: no part stands for it

nodes.name: Browser client
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer in each pane

nodes.name: Fetch semantic reads
nodes.responsibility: Decode the listing, a board, a render, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality
nodes.description: Plain fetch to the semantic read routes; refused, unreachable or invalid replies become explicit viewer failures carrying the server's code. There is no write call.

nodes.name: Resolve board meaning
nodes.responsibility: Inspect subjects and variants
nodes.description: Parses the board document, resolves the shown variant, describes nodes, edges, flows, steps, bindings, containment, and proposal standing.

nodes.name: Render stage states
nodes.responsibility: Present every reachable state
nodes.description: The pane's components. stageBody in SemanticStageView.tsx presents the waiting, problem, empty and drawn states, and says when the picture on screen is old, from the entry point's query and reading state. SemanticDiagram draws the picture and mounts its transition, gestures, lighting and marks. SemanticStageView lays the header with its way back and its two tabs, Diagram and About, the variant's standing, the About page over the picture while its tab is open, and the sidebar around them. The About page reads the board document the pane already holds: the variant's walkthroughs step by step, its parts in their containment, its relationships and the board's variants. A row picks its subject in the pane, a step presents its walkthrough from there, and a variant is read in the pane. The page writes nothing. SemanticBoardStage.tsx and Peek.tsx in the same directory are parts of their own. The header shows the board warning count and steps through each finding. A finding, like the control at the end of a row of the About page, asks the entry point to show its subject on the diagram.

nodes.name: Camera arithmetic
nodes.responsibility: Computes clamped camera transforms and fits without persisting board geometry
nodes.description: Pure camera.ts arithmetic supplies pan, pinch, zoom and fit transforms. The separate camera controller owns the live presentation store and when movement rests.

nodes.name: Select semantic subjects
nodes.responsibility: Map gestures through the atlas
nodes.description: Accepts only semantic IDs present in the server atlas and toggles the shared attention mark on rendered groups.

nodes.name: Follow drill-downs
nodes.responsibility: Navigate linked board levels, in this vault or another repository's
nodes.description: Decides where a link lies: the vault it is drawn in, the vault of the chosen checkout of the repository it names, or nowhere this machine can read (not listed, or a checkout that is gone or has no vault). Resolves the exact current or named target variant against the target board's document and says its lifecycle before it is opened; a named variant that is gone is reported, never swapped for the current one.

nodes.name: Drive walkthrough focus
nodes.responsibility: Focus each narrative beat
nodes.description: Maps beat subjects through the atlas to a focus rectangle and reports named subjects missing from the current view.

nodes.name: Refresh changed boards
nodes.responsibility: Invalidate live cached drawings
nodes.description: Hears a board's new version, with the vault it was written in, from the pane socket and, for the board on screen in that vault (or a name it had before a rename), cancels its reads in flight and invalidates its pictures and its document, keeping the last usable picture on screen.

nodes.name: Viewer entry point
nodes.responsibility: Mount queries and reading state
nodes.description: SemanticBoardStage, mounted by ApplicationPane. It asks the query cache for the picture of the reading on screen, owns the reading hooks (drill trail, level, variant, walkthrough, fit, report) and hands the answer to renderedView. It keeps the open tab, and how far down the About page was, with the board on screen. Its one show picks a subject, opens the diagram and fits the camera to the subject after the pick's own camera moves. A subject that the view on screen does not draw opens the whole board first.

nodes.name: Picture source
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's pictures come from: the renderer this page installed at start, or the server's render route

nodes.name: Picture cache
nodes.responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
nodes.description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown. A picture is of a board of one vault, so its key names the vault, and a listing forgets only the stale pictures of the vault it lists.

nodes.name: Draw here
nodes.responsibility: Draws the board in this tab, with the tab's own canvas and worker pool

nodes.name: Semantic queries
nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document, a picture and a board's locality
nodes.description: No timer: a picture and a document stay fresh until their board announces a new version, and are read again on a reconnect. The last picture of the same board stays as the placeholder while another reading of it is drawn. A board's locality is asked once for each pick of a part, and never on a timer, a return to the tab or a reconnect. Every key names a vault, because two repositories can each have a board of the same name: a board's news invalidates the keys of its own vault only.

nodes.name: Local pictures
nodes.responsibility: Draws a picture in this page from the board and policy the cache holds, and keeps it
nodes.description: Shows a kept picture only when its stamp matches the board's version, the policy and the renderer build; forgets pictures of boards that moved when the server lists them; draws a changed board's readings again ahead of time.

nodes.name: Keep fitted
nodes.responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms; lands at once on the board a flight arrived at
nodes.description: A new board, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back. The board a flight arrived at is fitted at once, because the flight has already put the camera there.

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading
nodes.responsibility: Tells the pane what is on screen, only when it changes
nodes.description: Board, resolved variant, view, selection, the drawn version and where a presented walkthrough has got to: what the pane session reports to the server, what an agent and voice read, and what a recording paces itself by.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers the semantic read routes

nodes.name: Camera glide
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
nodes.description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

nodes.name: Picture transition
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and the traffic's clock carries over; a picture a flight arrived at is put up as it is
nodes.description: It writes the picture into the surface itself, once per picture, and runs the traffic of each picture, ghost and borrowed group as it puts them up. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock, and the picture clock its traffic runs on is read and set through it, so a replay seeks every one of them to the frame's time. The picture of a board that a flight into a card arrived at is put up as it is, with no entrance. Continuing cards carry their one shared chip and moving words; content comparison ignores the per-picture placement properties, so a moved card keeps its shared content (picture-pairing.ts).

nodes.name: Board reads
nodes.responsibility: Where a board's document, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
nodes.description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation. A replay reads no findings and no locality.

nodes.name: Frame clock
nodes.responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
nodes.description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation at the frame's time: a picture's traffic, which carries the picture clock's id, at where that picture's clock stands, carried from the picture it replaced. An animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.

nodes.name: Walkthrough replay
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer on a recorded talk and steps it frame by frame
nodes.description: The page a recording's picture is rendered in (drawn on Browser application and Board rasterizer). Loading a talk points the board reads at it, installs the stepped clock and mounts the viewer on the talk's board, its step driven by the talk.

nodes.name: Picture traffic
nodes.responsibility: Runs a picture's traffic as Web Animations, so no SMIL runs in the page
nodes.description: The renderer draws traffic as SMIL so an exported file moves on its own. Before markup reaches the page, each SMIL element is taken out and kept as markup in an attribute of the element it animated, and its motion runs from there as a Web Animation that carries the picture clock's id. A copy of the picture keeps the attribute, so a ghost or a borrowed group runs its traffic again. A form it does not read stays SMIL.

nodes.name: Camera motion
nodes.responsibility: Eases the camera to where a wheel or a key sent it, a frame at a time
nodes.description: Each eased input changes where the camera is going. The loop keeps the zoom point under the pointer, ends when the camera is at rest and asks the frame clock for work only while moving. A pinch and a drag bypass this loop and apply at once; reduced motion also applies at once.

nodes.name: Diagram gestures
nodes.responsibility: Turns a press, a drag, a two-finger pinch and a click into a pan, a zoom, a pick or an open
nodes.description: A press within the pick tolerance selects what it landed on. A drag pans immediately and stops where released. A second touch pointer hands the gesture to useTouchPinch, which calls the camera controller with both fingers before and after each move. A press stops an eased move already under way.

nodes.name: Light connections
nodes.responsibility: Lights what a poked part is wired to and lets the rest of the picture recede
nodes.description: The part is the one the pointer has rested on for a moment, else the one picked out. The part, what it holds, every relationship with an end in any of it, the parts at their other ends and the containers that hold them stay as drawn; the surface says how strongly (pick or pointer). It stands down while a presented step or a group says what the picture is about, while the picture leaves, and for a part with nothing drawn to light.

nodes.name: Draw on lit relationships
nodes.responsibility: Draws each relationship that lights on from its source to its target, once
nodes.description: A sweep is a copy of the line laid over the picture for as long as it takes, animated on the document timeline, then settled into the line under it and taken away. The picture is not changed. A person who asked for reduced motion gets no sweep.

nodes.name: Ask the picture to show
nodes.responsibility: Carries what the sidebar asks of the picture: the relationship a row is pointed at, and a trace of what a part reaches
nodes.description: The stage provides it over the picture and the sidebar, which are siblings. Both asks belong to the part that is picked out and go when the pick does.

nodes.name: Trace what a part reaches
nodes.responsibility: Walks the relationships from a part, and what it holds, in one direction, and says how many hops away each subject is
nodes.description: Onward follows what the part sends to, back follows what sends to it. A subject reached by more than one route is as near as its nearest. The count of parts reached labels the control that asks for the trace.

nodes.name: Reveal a pick
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera, once, just far enough to bring a part picked from elsewhere than the picture into view
nodes.description: A row of the list, the part search or an agent can pick a part that is out of the pane. The part the reader was on comes along when the two are wired together and fit. A part already in view moves nothing, and a presented walkthrough or a panel over the picture keeps the camera.

nodes.name: Fly into a card
nodes.responsibility: Opens a card's board by flying the camera into the card, and goes back out the same way; a request it cannot fly opens the plain way
nodes.description: The flight holds the camera controller's rest from takeoff until the opened board has taken over and fitted. Both pictures inherit the same near or far reading during the flight; releasing the hold applies the opened board's reading once. Reduced motion, missing prefetched pictures and interrupted flights use the plain opening path.

nodes.name: Work out the flight
nodes.responsibility: Where a board sits inside its card, and the cameras at the two ends of the flight, so the end stands where the opened board stands

nodes.name: Place a board in its card
nodes.responsibility: Puts the board's picture inside its card on the surface, fades the two pictures across the flight, and lets a press end it
nodes.description: A flight fades the shared chip along with both layers of words, and the child picture inherits the surface's held near or far reading.

nodes.name: Open or leave a board
nodes.responsibility: Follows a card's drill-down and goes back a level, handing each to the flight with the plain move to end it with

nodes.name: Light the whole route
nodes.responsibility: Gives a lit relationship its own ink on a stretch of a shared lane that the picture has another relationship draw, so the line is lit from its source to its target

nodes.name: Camera controller
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera controls, immediate pinches, eased wheel and key moves, and when the camera rests
nodes.description: useBoardCamera creates one external camera store, delegates arithmetic to camera.ts and easing to useCameraMotion, and exposes camera reads and subscriptions to the diagram and its surface. A hand's move rests after cameraRest and after its ease ends. A zoom drops its compositor layer first, then releases the far reading on the next frame; a pan rests immediately.

nodes.name: Camera store
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the live camera, its last resting camera, the moving flag and subscribers outside React
nodes.description: Only subscribed presentation readers redraw on a camera change. While a hand moves it or a flight holds it, the rest stays where it was. The surface reads moving to keep its transform layer; SemanticDiagram reads rest.scale for the near/far swap and traffic resumes from the same rest. This is presentation state, never a copy of board meaning.

nodes.name: Mark code warnings
nodes.responsibility: Draws the picture's warning triangle on each subject the last code pass warns about
nodes.description: Reads the findings of the board, variant and version on screen and puts the renderer's own warning mark in the subject's group, where the picture puts it on an undecided subject. The picture's markup stays the renderer's; information draws nothing.

nodes.name: Page start
nodes.responsibility: Starts this page's renderer and hands the viewer its picture source and cache once; learns the vault the server serves before the application renders, or replays a recorded talk

nodes.name: Catalogue queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the board listing for catalogue navigation

nodes.name: Vault diagnostic queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the vault check for its diagnostics panel

nodes.name: Pane vault
nodes.responsibility: Tells every reader in a pane which vault the pane is in
nodes.description: The pane provides its vault once, as a context, and each reader of the viewer takes it from here instead of through every component between them. The pane session is its one source: the value only passes down, and a reader drawn outside a pane is an error, because it could not say which vault it means.

nodes.name: Open a card's board
nodes.responsibility: Opens the board one level down from a card, in its own vault or in the vault of the repository the link names
nodes.description: Finds where the link lies, reads the target there, and opens the variant the link names. A link into a repository this machine cannot read opens nothing, and the inspector says why.

nodes.name: Keep the drill trail
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the boards a reader came through, also across the move of the pane into another repository's vault
nodes.description: The trail is a pure reducer (lib/drill-trail.ts). A board of another vault is a move that the browser client makes: the trail waits for that arrival and keeps the boards before it. Any other arrival is somebody else pointing the pane, and ends the trail.

nodes.name: Repository places
nodes.responsibility: The vault of each repository this machine lists, which the browser client provides to the viewer

nodes.name: Picture supply
nodes.responsibility: Decides where a pane's picture is drawn, in this page or by the server's render route. Keeps each drawing only as a read-only cache stamped with the board version it came from.

nodes.name: Stage and reads
nodes.responsibility: Mounts the viewer in a pane and reads the board, its vault and the code findings from the server. Presents every reachable state of the answer and reports what is on screen.

nodes.name: Camera and pointer
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera, its fits, glides and eased moves. Turns presses, drags and hovers into picks and lit relationships.

nodes.name: Moves between pictures
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next, with the traffic each picture runs. Steps a walkthrough and follows a card's drill-down, in this vault or another repository's.

nodes.name: Variant timeline
nodes.responsibility: A board's variants as one timeline from its own record: the adopted line newest first, drafts branching off, a shelved variant ending its branch

nodes.name: Picture departure
nodes.responsibility: A picture leaving a pane for another board: it zooms into an opened card, draws away going back, else fades, and a late leaver finishes as a ghost

nodes.name: Board change feed
nodes.responsibility: Tells every pane that shows a board when the server announced a new version of it, so the pane reads it again

nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's pictures come from: the renderer this page installed at start, or the server's render route

nodes.name: Picture cache
nodes.responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
nodes.description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown. A picture is of a board of one vault, so its key names the vault, and a listing forgets only the stale pictures of the vault it lists.

nodes.name: Draw here
nodes.responsibility: Draws the board in this tab, with the tab's own canvas and worker pool

nodes.name: Semantic queries
nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document, a picture and a board's locality
nodes.description: No timer: a picture and a document stay fresh until their board announces a new version, and are read again on a reconnect. The last picture of the same board stays as the placeholder while another reading of it is drawn. A board's locality is asked once for each pick of a part, and never on a timer, a return to the tab or a reconnect. Every key names a vault, because two repositories can each have a board of the same name: a board's news invalidates the keys of its own vault only.

nodes.name: Local pictures
nodes.responsibility: Draws a picture in this page from the board and policy the cache holds, and keeps it
nodes.description: Shows a kept picture only when its stamp matches the board's version, the policy and the renderer build; forgets pictures of boards that moved when the server lists them; draws a changed board's readings again ahead of time.

nodes.name: Keep fitted
nodes.responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms; lands at once on the board a flight arrived at
nodes.description: A new board, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back. The board a flight arrived at is fitted at once, because the flight has already put the camera there.

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading
nodes.responsibility: Tells the pane what is on screen, only when it changes
nodes.description: Board, resolved variant, view, selection, the drawn version and where a presented walkthrough has got to: what the pane session reports to the server, what an agent and voice read, and what a recording paces itself by.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers the semantic read routes

nodes.name: Camera glide
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
nodes.description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

nodes.name: Picture transition
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and the traffic's clock carries over; a picture a flight arrived at is put up as it is
nodes.description: It writes the picture into the surface itself, once per picture, and runs the traffic of each picture, ghost and borrowed group as it puts them up. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock, and the picture clock its traffic runs on is read and set through it, so a replay seeks every one of them to the frame's time. The picture of a board that a flight into a card arrived at is put up as it is, with no entrance. Continuing cards carry their one shared chip and moving words; content comparison ignores the per-picture placement properties, so a moved card keeps its shared content (picture-pairing.ts).

nodes.name: Board reads
nodes.responsibility: Where a board's document, the vault check, the code findings and a board's locality are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
nodes.description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation. A replay reads no findings and no locality.

nodes.name: Frame clock
nodes.responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
nodes.description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation at the frame's time: a picture's traffic, which carries the picture clock's id, at where that picture's clock stands, carried from the picture it replaced. An animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.

nodes.name: Walkthrough replay
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer on a recorded talk and steps it frame by frame
nodes.description: The page a recording's picture is rendered in (drawn on Browser application and Board rasterizer). Loading a talk points the board reads at it, installs the stepped clock and mounts the viewer on the talk's board, its step driven by the talk.

nodes.name: Picture traffic
nodes.responsibility: Runs a picture's traffic as Web Animations, so no SMIL runs in the page
nodes.description: The renderer draws traffic as SMIL so an exported file moves on its own. Before markup reaches the page, each SMIL element is taken out and kept as markup in an attribute of the element it animated, and its motion runs from there as a Web Animation that carries the picture clock's id. A copy of the picture keeps the attribute, so a ghost or a borrowed group runs its traffic again. A form it does not read stays SMIL.

nodes.name: Camera motion
nodes.responsibility: Eases the camera to where a wheel or a key sent it, a frame at a time
nodes.description: Each eased input changes where the camera is going. The loop keeps the zoom point under the pointer, ends when the camera is at rest and asks the frame clock for work only while moving. A pinch and a drag bypass this loop and apply at once; reduced motion also applies at once.

nodes.name: Diagram gestures
nodes.responsibility: Turns a press, a drag, a two-finger pinch and a click into a pan, a zoom, a pick or an open
nodes.description: A press within the pick tolerance selects what it landed on. A drag pans immediately and stops where released. A second touch pointer hands the gesture to useTouchPinch, which calls the camera controller with both fingers before and after each move. A press stops an eased move already under way.

nodes.name: Light connections
nodes.responsibility: Lights what a poked part is wired to and lets the rest of the picture recede
nodes.description: The part is the one the pointer has rested on for a moment, else the one picked out. The part, what it holds, every relationship with an end in any of it, the parts at their other ends and the containers that hold them stay as drawn; the surface says how strongly (pick or pointer). It stands down while a presented step or a group says what the picture is about, while the picture leaves, and for a part with nothing drawn to light.

nodes.name: Draw on lit relationships
nodes.responsibility: Draws each relationship that lights on from its source to its target, once
nodes.description: A sweep is a copy of the line laid over the picture for as long as it takes, animated on the document timeline, then settled into the line under it and taken away. The picture is not changed. A person who asked for reduced motion gets no sweep.

nodes.name: Ask the picture to show
nodes.responsibility: Carries what the sidebar asks of the picture: the relationship a row is pointed at, and a trace of what a part reaches
nodes.description: The stage provides it over the picture and the sidebar, which are siblings. Both asks belong to the part that is picked out and go when the pick does.

nodes.name: Trace what a part reaches
nodes.responsibility: Walks the relationships from a part, and what it holds, in one direction, and says how many hops away each subject is
nodes.description: Onward follows what the part sends to, back follows what sends to it. A subject reached by more than one route is as near as its nearest. The count of parts reached labels the control that asks for the trace.

nodes.name: Reveal a pick
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera, once, just far enough to bring a part picked from elsewhere than the picture into view
nodes.description: A row of the list, the part search or an agent can pick a part that is out of the pane. The part the reader was on comes along when the two are wired together and fit. A part already in view moves nothing, and a presented walkthrough or a panel over the picture keeps the camera.

nodes.name: Fly into a card
nodes.responsibility: Opens a card's board by flying the camera into the card, and goes back out the same way; a request it cannot fly opens the plain way
nodes.description: The flight holds the camera controller's rest from takeoff until the opened board has taken over and fitted. Both pictures inherit the same near or far reading during the flight; releasing the hold applies the opened board's reading once. Reduced motion, missing prefetched pictures and interrupted flights use the plain opening path.

nodes.name: Work out the flight
nodes.responsibility: Where a board sits inside its card, and the cameras at the two ends of the flight, so the end stands where the opened board stands

nodes.name: Place a board in its card
nodes.responsibility: Puts the board's picture inside its card on the surface, fades the two pictures across the flight, and lets a press end it
nodes.description: A flight fades the shared chip along with both layers of words, and the child picture inherits the surface's held near or far reading.

nodes.name: Open or leave a board
nodes.responsibility: Follows a card's drill-down and goes back a level, handing each to the flight with the plain move to end it with

nodes.name: Light the whole route
nodes.responsibility: Gives a lit relationship its own ink on a stretch of a shared lane that the picture has another relationship draw, so the line is lit from its source to its target

nodes.name: Camera controller
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera controls, immediate pinches, eased wheel and key moves, and when the camera rests
nodes.description: useBoardCamera creates one external camera store, delegates arithmetic to camera.ts and easing to useCameraMotion, and exposes camera reads and subscriptions to the diagram and its surface. A hand's move rests after cameraRest and after its ease ends. A zoom drops its compositor layer first, then releases the far reading on the next frame; a pan rests immediately.

nodes.name: Camera store
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the live camera, its last resting camera, the moving flag and subscribers outside React
nodes.description: Only subscribed presentation readers redraw on a camera change. While a hand moves it or a flight holds it, the rest stays where it was. The surface reads moving to keep its transform layer; SemanticDiagram reads rest.scale for the near/far swap and traffic resumes from the same rest. This is presentation state, never a copy of board meaning.

nodes.name: Mark code warnings
nodes.responsibility: Draws the picture's warning triangle on each subject the last code pass warns about
nodes.description: Reads the findings of the board, variant and version on screen and puts the renderer's own warning mark in the subject's group, where the picture puts it on an undecided subject. The picture's markup stays the renderer's; information draws nothing.

nodes.name: Page start
nodes.responsibility: Starts this page's renderer and hands the viewer its picture source and cache once; learns the vault the server serves before the application renders, or replays a recorded talk

nodes.name: Catalogue queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the board listing for catalogue navigation

nodes.name: Vault diagnostic queries
nodes.responsibility: Reads the vault check for its diagnostics panel

nodes.name: Pane vault
nodes.responsibility: Tells every reader in a pane which vault the pane is in
nodes.description: The pane provides its vault once, as a context, and each reader of the viewer takes it from here instead of through every component between them. The pane session is its one source: the value only passes down, and a reader drawn outside a pane is an error, because it could not say which vault it means.

nodes.name: Open a card's board
nodes.responsibility: Opens the board one level down from a card, in its own vault or in the vault of the repository the link names
nodes.description: Finds where the link lies, reads the target there, and opens the variant the link names. A link into a repository this machine cannot read opens nothing, and the inspector says why.

nodes.name: Keep the drill trail
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the boards a reader came through, also across the move of the pane into another repository's vault
nodes.description: The trail is a pure reducer (lib/drill-trail.ts). A board of another vault is a move that the browser client makes: the trail waits for that arrival and keeps the boards before it. Any other arrival is somebody else pointing the pane, and ends the trail.

nodes.name: Repository places
nodes.responsibility: The vault of each repository this machine lists, which the browser client provides to the viewer

nodes.name: Picture supply
nodes.responsibility: Decides where a pane's picture is drawn, in this page or by the server's render route. Keeps each drawing only as a read-only cache stamped with the board version it came from.

nodes.name: Stage and reads
nodes.responsibility: Mounts the viewer in a pane and reads the board, its vault and the code findings from the server. Presents every reachable state of the answer and reports what is on screen.

nodes.name: Camera and pointer
nodes.responsibility: Owns the pane's camera, its fits, glides and eased moves. Turns presses, drags and hovers into picks and lit relationships.

nodes.name: Moves between pictures
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next, with the traffic each picture runs. Steps a walkthrough and follows a card's drill-down, in this vault or another repository's.

nodes.name: Variant timeline
nodes.responsibility: A board's variants as one timeline from its own record: the adopted line newest first, drafts branching off, a shelved variant ending its branch

nodes.name: Picture departure
nodes.responsibility: A picture leaving a pane for another board: it zooms into an opened card, draws away going back, else fades, and a late leaver finishes as a ghost

nodes.name: Board change feed
nodes.responsibility: Tells every pane that shows a board when the server announced a new version of it, so the pane reads it again
